## Où j'en suis
Work on QPAY-2291 (Corvane rejecting the 10 Nov payout file): the pre-upload NACHA validator (PR #1475) is merged, and the ACK watchdog (item 2) is written on branch `tomer/ack-watchdog` with PR #1481 open, based on `tomer/nacha-validator` and to be rebased now that #1475 landed. The watchdog pages on-call if no Corvane ACK arrives 45 min after upload; tests pass 14/14 after fixing a DST bug in `cutoff.rs` (switched to `chrono_tz::America::Chicago`). The page won't reach anyone until Elad routes the `payouts` PagerDuty service in terraform. Next task, per the user's last turn: write the postmortem doc for Friday's (Nov 20) review, which Tomer presents; Carla owes Loomly a written postmortem by Monday Nov 23. A secret from `.env.prod` was exposed in the transcript; the SFTP password is being rotated with Elad today. (source: ses-ach-3, v3-12, v3-13)

- [en-cours] PR #1481 (ack watchdog, branch `tomer/ack-watchdog`) is open, built on `tomer/nacha-validator`; needs rebase onto main now that #1475 is merged (source: ses-ach-3, quillon/core#1481)
- [prochaine-étape] Write the postmortem doc for the Friday Nov 20, 16:00 TLV review (source: v3-13, src-slack-avi)
- [prochaine-étape] Elad: PagerDuty routing for the payouts service in `quillon/terraform`, without it the watchdog's pages go nowhere (source: ses-ach-3, src-jira-2291)
- [prochaine-étape] Rebase #1481 onto main now that #1475 is merged (source: v3-12, quillon/core#1475)
- [essai-raté] First validator version passed the rejected 10 Nov file because it measured `record.trim_end().len()`; fixed to check raw length (source: ses-ach-2, v2-06)
- [essai-raté] Watchdog deadline test failed: `cutoff.rs` hardcoded a fixed UTC-5 offset (Central daylight time), so past DST end the deadline computed an hour early and would page nightly; fixed with `chrono_tz::America::Chicago` in `cutoff.rs` and `settlement_window()` (source: v3-04, v3-06)
- [question] Nothing open to decide; the fail-closed policy and truncation idea conflict is resolved below (source: ses-ach-3)
- [décision] The validator fails closed: it blocks the upload and pages, never silently modifies a field (source: v2-03, src-slack-avi)
- [décision] Runbooks list env var names only, never values from `.env.prod`; the leaked Corvane SFTP password is being rotated with Elad (source: v3-09)
- [décision] Root cause: commit d17c0e5 (QPAY-2270) set `company_entry_description` to the 13-char `QUILLONPAYOUT`; the writer pads but never truncates, so batch 3's header was 97 chars — 1,840 entries / $2,316,904.17 settled ~30h late (source: ses-ach-1, v1-02, v1-04)
